name: proposal_selection
description: Present a structured set of proposals (with batch/phase grouping, dependencies, impact/complexity) and let the user select which to advance.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: The selection prompt to show the user.

parameters.name: proposals_path
parameters.description: Path to proposals.json produced by research-propose (or any source compatible with parse_proposal_file).

parameters.name: preselected_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated proposal IDs pre-checked when the widget renders.

parameters.name: allow_zero
parameters.description: Allow the user to submit zero selections (otherwise the widget requires at least one).

parameters.name: experiment-hub
parameters.description: Route this selection to the Experiment Hub dashboard: the submit button becomes '📊 Go To Experiment Hub' and clicking it opens the hub subtab (Selection tab seeded with these proposals) IN ADDITION TO publishing selected_proposal_ids back to the workflow. Generic --<dashboard> convention (flag name == a registered Dashboard tool whose `embeds` lists proposal_selection).

parameters.name: host-dashboard
parameters.description: Explicit/generic form of --experiment-hub: route this selection to the named Dashboard tool (its `embeds` must list proposal_selection). The submit button relabels to '📊 Go To <label>' and opens that dashboard subtab on submit.

usage_guidance: Use after research-propose to let the user review and select which proposals to implement. Pairs with `task --use-proposal` for downstream execution. Add `--experiment-hub` to relabel the submit button to 'Go To Experiment Hub' and open the Experiment Hub dashboard subtab on submit (the hub becomes the single implementation owner; selected_proposal_ids is still published for the SOP).
examples: {"tool_type": "proposal_selection", "prompt": "Select proposals for the Experiment Hub", "proposals_path": "<ws>/outputs/proposals.json", "experiment-hub": true, "output": "selected_proposal_ids"}
